desc: The daughters-in-law ask AJ for 'shagun' to let him enter his room and when he gets angry, Durga gives him a hint of his hypocrisy. Later, Parv enters Guddan's room and touches her inappropriately.

title: Guddan Tumse Na Ho Payega
desc: AJ retaliates against Guddan's allegations and says that he never forced her to marry him. Later, Parv informs Kaushalya that he loves Revati and promises to keep her happy.
